os_unknown: This computer’s OS is not known yet. Try again once it connects.
no_binary: The hub has no node build for {os}/{arch} and no release to fetch one from. Run scripts/deploy/deploy.sh on your development machine, put a {name} of the hub’s version in its bin/nodes folder, or set node_packages in hub.json (docs/operations/docker.md, “Node builds”).
no_package: The newest release, {version}, has no {os}/{arch} node build this hub can drive, and there is none of the hub’s own version. Update the hub, or put a {name} of its version in its bin/nodes folder (docs/operations/docker.md, “Node builds”).
no_release: There is no node build for {os}/{arch} of the hub’s version, and no release at its node packages address to take one from. Put a {name} of the hub’s version in its bin/nodes folder, or set node_packages.url in hub.json (docs/operations/docker.md, “Node builds”).
package_unreachable: Could not reach the release for the {os}/{arch} node build: {err}. Check the hub’s internet access or node_packages.proxy in hub.json, or put the build in its bin/nodes folder (docs/operations/docker.md, “Node builds”).
package_bad: The {os}/{arch} node build from the release did not check out, so it was not used: {err}
not_back: Installed, but this computer did not reconnect to the hub within {wait}.
not_back_why: Installed, but this computer did not reconnect to the hub within {wait}: {why}
still_old: Installed, but this computer still runs {version}. Restart personad on that computer.
save_task_failed: Could not save the update task: {err}
save_result_failed: Update confirmed, but its result could not be saved: {err}
idle_check_failed: Could not check whether this computer is idle: {err}
open_package_failed: Could not open the node update package: {err}
prepare_failed: Could not prepare the node update: {err}
bad_transaction: The node returned an invalid update transaction.
bad_offset: The node returned an invalid update transfer offset.
read_package_failed: Could not read the node update package: {err}
transfer_failed: Could not transfer the node update: {err}
wrong_offset: The node confirmed the wrong update transfer offset.
install_update_failed: Could not install the node update: {err}
not_confirmed: The new node did not reconnect and confirm its version within two minutes. Local recovery will roll back after confirmation times out. Check the computer’s status and try again.
hub_changed: The hub version changed, so the previous node update was stopped. Start the update again.
rolled_back: The node still runs the old version after updating and may have rolled back. Check the computer’s status and retry manually.
node_temporary: This connection uses a temporary node. Install the resident node service first.
node_unmanaged: The resident node is not managed by launchd/systemd, so recovery after failure cannot be guaranteed.
node_no_ps: ps is missing, so the rollback process cannot be verified.
node_ps_no_start: ps here cannot report a process’s start time (BusyBox’s cannot; install procps), so the rollback process cannot be verified.
node_windows_unsupervised: This computer’s Persona Link background service does not take updates for its node yet. Run persona-link install on the computer once.
node_no_systemd_run: systemd-run is missing, so the independent rollback monitor cannot start.
node_no_executable: Could not locate the resident node’s executable.
node_bad_executable: The resident node’s executable is unavailable.
node_no_restart: The resident node has no process restart entry point.
node_recovery_pending: The previous update has not recovered safely: {err}
node_unwritable: The resident node’s executable directory is not writable.
node_busy: node_update_busy: An agent is still working or waiting for input. Try again later.
